provenance.notes: Upstream models 10 skills per hero (70 total, one stub with no effect). Official: 11 Skill tokens per hero, of which the skill not used in the current mode is removed (MKUE Walkthrough p.5; MKUE Rulebook p.3). The 11th (missing) token is the non-selected interactive skill; DISCREPANCY noted in game-data/README.md.
